# Dogfooding Review Checklist

Use this quick reference during testing sessions.

## Pre-Test Setup
```
□ App is running
□ Testing on target device (mobile/desktop)
□ Fresh session (cleared cache if needed)
□ You have 15-20 minutes
```

## Real-Time Testing Notes
As you play, jot down reactions:
```
⏱️ Time: 0:00 - First load
   - Visual reaction: _______________
   - Emotional reaction: _______________
   - Friction noted: _______________

⏱️ Time: X:XX - [Key moment]
   - What happened: _______________
   - How did it feel?: _______________
   - Would I do this again?: _______________
```

## Post-Test Evaluation Matrix

| Area | Works Well ✅ | Missing/Broken ❌ | Priority |
|------|----------------|-------------------|----------|
| Visual Engagement | | | |
| Audio/Sound | | | |
| Content Quality | | | |
| Progression | | | |
| Celebration | | | |
| Social Element | | | |
| Replayability | | | |
| Real-World Context | | | |

## Final Verdict
```
Current Fun Factor:  _/10
Why: _________________________________

Potential Fun Factor:  _/10
Why: _________________________________

One change that moves the needle most:
_________________________________

Would I play this again? YES / NO
```

## Impact/Effort Matrix Template

```
             HIGH EFFORT          MEDIUM EFFORT       LOW EFFORT
HIGH IMPACT  [Strategic]          [Tactical]          🔴 DO FIRST
             (schedule later)     (medium priority)   

MEDIUM IMP   [Polish]             [Nice-to-have]      🟡 CONSIDER
             (if time allows)     (low priority)      

LOW IMPACT   [SKIP]               [SKIP]              [SKIP]
```

---

**Remember**: Be brutally honest. "This feature kills engagement because X" > "This is bad"
